## What it is

The tower at 270°, the front. Four notches. Four clips on a 1 m strip, including the highest.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The lug is 11 mm outboard of the pin.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't leave the cap off. This tower's top is what the cap is there to hold at the radius.
